name: Upromise® World Mastercard®

apr.notes: Purchases – 18.49% to 29.49%, based on your creditworthiness and other factors. This APR will vary with the market based on the Prime Rate. Balance transfers – 0% introductory APR for the first fifteen billing cycles following each balance transfer that posts to your account within 45 days of account opening. After that, 18.49% to 29.49%.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees on international purchases.

base_rate.description: Earn 1.25% cash back rewards on purchases if Upromise Program account is not linked to a College Savings Plan. Earn 1.529% cash back rewards when linked to an eligible College Savings Plan.

rewards.redemption_notes: Upromise Round Up lets you round up purchases to the nearest dollar; total Round Up Amount is considered a purchase and converted to cash back rewards.

signup_bonus.description: Earn $100 Bonus Cash Back Rewards after spending $500 on purchases in the first 90 days

benefits.title: No foreign transaction fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees on international purchases.

benefits.title: $0 Fraud Liability Protection
benefits.description: You're not responsible for charges you did not authorize.

benefits.title: Free online access to your FICO Credit Score
benefits.description: Free online access to your FICO Credit Score lets you keep an eye on your credit score and get email alerts when we learn that your score has changed.

benefits.title: Low Intro Balance Transfer Offer
benefits.description: 0% introductory APR for 15 months on balance transfers made within 45 days of account opening. After that, a variable APR will apply, 18.49% to 29.49%. There is a fee for balance transfers.

notes: Verified against official Barclays product page on 2026-07-24.
